action.command:
cd /tmp
php -r "copy('https://getcomposer.org/installer', 'composer-setup.php');"
php composer-setup.php --quiet --install-dir=/usr/local/bin --filename=composer 2>&1 | tail -3
rm -f composer-setup.php
composer --version 2>&1
echo "---node---"
curl -fsSL https://deb.nodesource.com/setup_22.x -o /tmp/nodesetup.sh
bash /tmp/nodesetup.sh 2>&1 | tail -5
DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y -qq nodejs 2>&1 | tail -3
node -v; npm -v
